summary: Expanded the QBO plan to include a standalone, idempotent company bootstrapping CLI.
name: quickbooks-online-plan
pending_tasks: Await plan approval, then implement the bootstrap service, CLI, and remaining integration.
decisions: Goal: QBO scope. Decision: first release covers all outbound financial flows. Why: user selected all outbound. | Goal: posting model. Decision: hybrid—sales summarized by cycle, producer accounting individualized. Why: user preference. | Goal: QBO controls. Decision: automatic posting with validation exceptions held for staff. | Goal: runtime. Decision: process sync in existing web process, not a separate worker or CronJob. | Goal: history. Decision: start at a cutover cycle with no historical backfill. | Goal: accounting. Decision: US accrual basis; shopeatlocal remains member A/R subledger; shopeatlocal tax totals are authoritative. | Goal: dimensions. Decision: use QBO Classes for web, on-site retail, and wholesale. | Goal: producer accounting. Decision: detailed gross/fees/net represented as a gross Bill plus Vendor Credit for co-op and inventory fees; payouts originate in shopeatlocal and mark QBO bills paid. | Goal: payment handling. Decision: separate clearing accounts by payment method; Square settlement/fee reconciliation remains later/manual. | Goal: corrections. Decision: preserve synced records and post reversal/adjustment entries. | Goal: setup. Decision: Intuit sandbox exists and integration should auto-bootstrap baseline QBO accounts, items, Classes, and mappings. | Goal: payment batching. Decision: cycle summaries for sales/fees and daily summaries by payment method for payments/adjustments. Why: selected by user and supports clearing-account reconciliation. | Goal: exception alerts. Decision: staff dashboard plus email after repeated or terminal failures. | Goal: producer payout allocation. Decision: apply payouts FIFO to oldest open producer Bills/Vendor Credits, allowing partial payments. | Goal: API idempotency. Decision: persist one unique QBO requestid per logical write and reuse it for retries; verify by stable DocNumber after ambiguous timeouts. Why: this is Intuit's documented duplicate-prevention mechanism. | Goal: deployment scope. Decision: do not use or modify Kubernetes for the QBO integration. Configure credentials and encryption key through the app's ordinary runtime environment/configuration instead. | Goal: native Intuit integration. Decision: use the official intuit-oauth package for OAuthClient, scopes, authorization URL, code exchange, refresh, revoke, token validity, makeApiCall, environment URLs, Fault parsing, retry/error handling, and Intuit transaction IDs. | Goal: Accounting API SDK. Decision: do not use the unaffiliated community node-quickbooks package; use intuit-oauth.makeApiCall for documented Accounting API endpoints, with native fetch only for a demonstrably unsupported endpoint/transport. | Goal: QBO bootstrap. Decision: add app/scripts/bootstrap-quickbooks.js and npm script quickbooks:bootstrap, reusing the same bootstrap service as the admin UI. It operates on an already-authorized realm, supports --dry-run and --cutover-cycle, produces sanitized machine-readable output, audits actions, rejects environment/realm conflicts, and is safe to rerun.
constraints: The bootstrap CLI must not delete or rename existing accounting data automatically and must exit nonzero on validation/API failures. No Kubernetes.
assumptions: OAuth connection is completed through the web flow before the CLI bootstraps QBO company resources.
